title: A Multibias-mitigated and Sentiment Knowledge Enriched Transformer for Debiasing in Multimodal Conversational Emotion Recognition
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured stereotypical religious bias in GloVe word embeddings. The evaluation was done by checking the K-Means clustering accuracy of predefined sets of religious word pairs (e.g., 'Christian-Muslim', 'Jesus-Muhammad'). A lower clustering accuracy after debiasing indicates a successful reduction of bias.
findings: The study found significant religious bias in GloVe embeddings, which was measured by the separability of word clusters. Before debiasing, the top 1000 religiously biased words could be clustered with 96.6% accuracy. After applying the proposed debiasing method, this accuracy dropped to 81.6%, indicating that the biased associations were successfully reduced. The paper notes that religious bias and gender bias were the two most effectively mitigated categories among the five studied.
